sentences.en: SALLY: Good morning
sentences.zh: SALLY: 早上好。

sentences.en: Hinchingbrooke Country Park, Sally speaking
sentences.zh: 欣钦布鲁克国家公园，我是莎莉。

sentences.en: I'm one of the rangers
sentences.zh: 我是其中一名护林员。

sentences.en: JOHN: Oh hello
sentences.zh: JOHN: 哦，你好。

sentences.en: My name's John Chapman, and I'm a teaching assistant at a local primary school
sentences.zh: 我叫约翰·查普曼，是当地一所小学的教学助理。

sentences.en: I've been asked to arrange a visit to the park for two of our classes
sentences.zh: 学校委托我为两个班级安排一次公园参观活动。

sentences.en: SALLY: OK
sentences.zh: SALLY: 好的。

sentences.en: What would you like to know?
sentences.zh: 您想了解些什么？

sentences.en: JOHN: Well, I'm new to this area, so perhaps you could tell me something about the park first, please
sentences.zh: JOHN: 呃，我刚搬到这一带，所以请您先简单介绍一下这个公园，好吗？

sentences.en: SALLY: Of course
sentences.zh: SALLY: 当然可以。

sentences.en: Altogether the park covers 170 acres, that's 69 hectares
sentences.zh: 整个公园占地170英亩，即69公顷。

sentences.en: There are three main types of habitat: wetland, grassland and woodland
sentences.zh: 园内主要有三种栖息地类型：湿地、草原和林地。

sentences.en: The woods are well established and varied, with an oak plantation, and other areas of mixed species
sentences.zh: 林地发育成熟、种类丰富，既有橡树林区，也有其他多种树种混交的区域。

sentences.en: JOHN: Right
sentences.zh: JOHN: 明白了。

sentences.en: SALLY: The wetland is quite varied, too
sentences.zh: SALLY: 湿地同样具有高度多样性。

sentences.en: The original farmland was dug up around 40 years ago to extract gravel
sentences.zh: 大约40年前，这片原本是农田的土地被挖掘用于采掘砾石。

sentences.en: Once this work was completed, the gravel pits filled with water, forming the two large lakes
sentences.zh: 采掘工程结束后，留下的砾石坑逐渐积水，形成了两个大型湖泊。

sentences.en: There are also several smaller ones, ponds and a stream that flows through the park
sentences.zh: 此外还有若干小型湖泊、池塘以及一条流经公园的小溪。

sentences.en: JOHN: OK, so I suppose with these different habitats there's quite a variety of wildlife
sentences.zh: JOHN: 好的，那么我猜，凭借这些不同的栖息地，这里应该拥有相当丰富的野生动物资源。

sentences.en: SALLY: There certainly is - a lot of different species of birds and insects, and also animals like deer and rabbits
sentences.zh: SALLY: 的确如此——有大量不同种类的鸟类和昆虫，还有鹿、兔子等动物。

sentences.en: JOHN: And I understand you organise educational visits for school parties
sentences.zh: JOHN: 我了解到你们会为学校团体组织教育性参观活动。

sentences.en: SALLY: That's right
sentences.zh: SALLY: 没错。

sentences.en: We can organise a wide range of activities and adapt them to suit all ages
sentences.zh: 我们可以组织各种各样的活动，并根据所有年龄段学生的需求进行调整。

sentences.en: JOHN: Can you give me some examples of the activities?
sentences.zh: JOHN: 您能举几个活动类型的例子吗？

sentences.en: SALLY: Well, one S focus is on science, where we help children to discover and study plants, trees and insects
sentences.zh: SALLY: 好的，其中一个重点是科学类活动，我们帮助孩子们观察并研究植物、树木和昆虫。

sentences.en: They also collect and analyse data about the things they see
sentences.zh: 他们还会收集并分析所见事物的相关数据。

sentences.en: JOHN: Uhuh
sentences.zh: JOHN: 嗯。

sentences.en: SALLY: Another focus is on geography
sentences.zh: SALLY: 另一个重点是地理类活动。

sentences.en: The park iS a great environment to learn and practise reading a map and a using a compass to navigate around the park
sentences.zh: 公园是一个极佳的学习与实践环境，孩子们可在此学习阅读地图，并使用指南针在园内导航。

sentences.en: JOHN: Do you do anything connected with history?
sentences.zh: JOHN: 那么，你们有没有与历史相关的活动呢？

sentences.en: SALLY: Yes, we do
sentences.zh: SALLY: 有的。

sentences.en: For instance, the children can explore how the use of the land has changed over time
sentences.zh: 例如，孩子们可以探究这片土地用途随时间推移而发生的变迁。

sentences.en: Then there's leisure and tourism
sentences.zh: 此外还有休闲与旅游主题。

sentences.en: JOHN: That focuses on your visitors, I would imagine
sentences.zh: JOHN: 我想这主要聚焦于你们的游客吧。

sentences.en: SALLY: Yes, mostly
sentences.zh: SALLY: 是的，主要是这样。

sentences.en: The children find out about them, their requirements, the problems they may cause and how we manage these
sentences.zh: 孩子们会了解游客群体、他们的需求、可能带来的问题，以及我们如何应对和管理这些问题。

sentences.en: And another subject we cover iS
sentences.zh: 我们涵盖的另一门学科是

sentences.en: music: here the children experiment with natural materials to create sounds and explore rhythm and tempo
sentences.zh: 音乐：孩子们利用天然材料尝试制作声音，并探索节奏与速度。

sentences.en: JOHN: That must be fun!
sentences.zh: JOHN: 这一定很有趣！

sentences.en: SALLY: Most children really enjoy it
sentences.zh: SALLY: 大多数孩子都非常喜欢这项活动。

sentences.en: SALLY: And of course, all the activities are educational, too
sentences.zh: SALLY: 当然，所有活动也都具有教育意义。

sentences.en: Learning outside the classroom encourages children to be creative, and to explore and discover for themselves
sentences.zh: 在课堂外学习能鼓励孩子们发挥创造力，并自主探索和发现。

sentences.en: JOHN: would imagine they get a sense of freedom that might not be a normal part of their lives
sentences.zh: JOHN: 我想，孩子们会感受到一种自由感，而这种自由感或许在他们日常生活中并不常见。

sentences.en: SALLY: That's right
sentences.zh: SALLY: 没错。

sentences.en: And very often the children discover that they can do things they didn't know they could do, and they develop new skills
sentences.zh: 而且，孩子们常常会发现自己能够完成一些原本不知道自己能做到的事情，并由此发展出新的技能。

sentences.en: This gives them greater self-confidence
sentences.zh: 这会增强他们的自信心。

sentences.en: JOHN: It sounds great
sentences.zh: JOHN: 听起来很棒。

sentences.en: So, what about the practical side of it?
sentences.zh: 那么，实际操作方面情况如何呢？

sentences.en: How much does it cost for a full-day visit?
sentences.zh: 一整天参观的费用是多少？

sentences.en: We would expect to bring between 30 and 40 children
sentences.zh: 我们预计会带30至40名孩子参加。

sentences.en: SALLY: If there are over 30, it costs £4.95 for it each child who attends on the day
sentences.zh: SALLY: 如果人数超过30人，当天到场的每名儿童收费4.95英镑。

sentences.en: We invoice you afterwards, so you don't pay for children who can't come because of sickness, for example
sentences.zh: 我们会在之后向你们开具发票，因此，如果因生病等原因有孩子无法参加，你们无需为这些孩子付费。

sentences.en: There's no charge for leaders and other adults - as many as you want to bring
sentences.zh: 带队老师及其他成年陪同人员完全免费——你们想带多少人都可以。

sentences.en: JOHN: That sounds very fair
sentences.zh: JOHN: 这听起来非常合理。

sentences.en: Well, thanks for all the information
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常感谢您提供的所有信息。

sentences.en: I'll need to discuss it with my colleagues, and I hope to get back to you soon to make a booking
sentences.zh: 我需要先与我的同事们讨论一下，希望能尽快与您联系并确认预订。

sentences.en: SALLY: We'll look forward to hearing from you
sentences.zh: SALLY: 我们期待您的消息。

sentences.en: Goodbye
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: JOHN: Goodbye, and thank you
sentences.zh: JOHN: 再见，谢谢您。
